dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curve fitting a parabolic spline from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree posterior inclination relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc forming a bulbous, rounded anterior cranial profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Minimal protrusion length with a high thickness ratio relative to the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 165 degrees between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Non-biological teal-green translucent texture with internal luminosity and sharp, acute-tipped caudal flukes.
